4267-8266.easyPrerequisites: Divining Witch doesn't have summoning sickness. You have a card in hand.
4267-8266.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Divining Witch that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4267-8266.description:
Activate Divining Witch by paying {1}{B}, tapping it and discarding a card, naming a card not in your library and thus exiling your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to win the game.

719-1315-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-1315-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.

654-4125-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-4125-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-4125-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Shipwreck Dowser and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

3534-4247-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
You control seven or more lands with different names.
3534-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
3534-4247-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

3532-5078-5402-7913.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

575-1794-2921.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2173-2324-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-2544-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {1}{U} due to Biomancer's Familiar, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1806-2060-5231-6774-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

1636-4289-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
When the Faerie enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1395-1482-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1395-1482-2854-4574.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Showdown of the Skalds trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2341-3649-5334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2341-3649-5334.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability twice due to Roaming Throne.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying either of Etrata's triggers.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

2957-4508-6310.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2957-4508-6310.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Shao Jun to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat from step 2.
2957-4508-6310.notes: Once you have one opponent remaining, the loop fails to create enough Treasures to sustain itself. You may use other artifacts as desired or wait another turn until your artifacts are untapped. If you have more than two opponents, this combo will net Treasure(s) per loop, and those can also be used once you only have one opponent remaining.

826-1636-6243-6797.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-6243-6797.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Coveted Jewel.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

2781-2921-4875-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2781-2921-4875-6243.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

488-641-874-3200-4986.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-874-3200-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4214-5189-5532.easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
4214-5189-5532.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
4214-5189-5532.description:
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Ghave.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

401-3558-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-3558-4050.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {1}.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

215-1812-2092-4617.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
215-1812-2092-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin three times by paying {3}, adding eight {R}.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Soulbright Flamekin to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

618-1453-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
618-1453-4613.description:
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat.

751-3519-4115.manaNeeded: {U} plus enough mana to cast the additional creature
751-3519-4115.notablePrerequisites:
You do not control another Drake or have a Drake in your graveyard.
You have another creature card in hand that is not a Drake and that does not share a creature type with a creature you control or a creature in your graveyard.
If the additional creature has multiple differently colored mana symbols in its mana cost, an additional mana of each but one of those symbols will be required.
751-3519-4115.description:
Cast the additional creature by paying its mana cost.
Volo triggers, copying the creature spell.
Resolve both creature spells.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the creature token, adding at least one mana of any color that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Volo triggers, copying Shrieking Drake.
Resolve the copy of the Shrieking Drake spell.
When the token Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning a nontoken creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the Shrieking Drake token, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Resolve the original Shrieking Drake spell cast in step 5.
When the nontoken Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2726-4512-4871.description:
Cast Sanitarium Skeleton by paying {B}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Sanitarium Skeleton.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sanitarium Skeleton and the Sanitarium Skeleton token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Sanitarium Skeletons die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Sanitarium Skeleton by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2459-3156-3652-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Rograkh, targeting Ornithopter.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Ornithopter, targeting Rograkh.
Ornithopter dies, triggering Koll, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Rograkh.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-3425-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
2034-3425-3490.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Celebrity Fencer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Celebrity Fencer.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Celebrity Fencer trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2493-4702-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer does not have summoning sickness.
2493-4702-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp.
Tap Archaeomancer, making a token copy of it.
The token enters, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2376-3575.notablePrerequisites:
Aerie Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
There is a creature with flying on the battlefield.
2376-3575.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing it, targeting any creature with flying.
When Aerie Ouphes dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counter on it due to Aerie Ouphes' riot ability.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Aerie Ouphes abilities, dealing infinite damage to the targeted creature(s).
